cuerpo.name: v0.9.95
cuerpo.body:
## Why 0.9.95 and not 1.0.0?

This release has almost everything planned for 1.0.0: a new design, a rebuilt player and hundreds of fixes. But so much has changed that it needs testing on more devices and libraries than we can cover ourselves.

So 0.9.95 is the last step before 1.0.0. The goal now is stability, not new features. If something breaks or looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/issues) with your device and app version. 1.0.0 will come once this version has proven solid.

## Highlights

* **Shiori, a new design for the whole app:** every screen has been redrawn on one design system, with new navigation, transitions and an ergonomic pass throughout (#1077).
* **A rebuilt video player:** new controls on phone, desktop and TV, plus video filters, audio delay, and volume, brightness and fit kept between episodes.
* **A tracker with no account:** follow your status, progress, score and dates on the device alone (#1121).
* **Work that keeps going on Android:** downloads, library updates, restores and syncs continue in the background, under one notification (#1092).
* **More control over downloads and updates:** download ahead while reading, download new chapters automatically, and choose which series a library update skips (#1091).

**Before updating:** this is a large release that also touches how your library is stored, so make a backup first (More > Backup and restore).

## Reader

* Zoom with Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) and the mouse wheel; the wheel alone moves a zoomed page.
* With "Navigate to pan" on, tall pages are read row by row before the page turns.
* Split tall images into slices in webtoon mode.
* Choose which chapters next and previous skip: read, filtered or duplicate.
* Rebind the reader's keyboard shortcuts.
* Separate icons for crop borders on and off.
* Pages and zooms follow your finger more closely, and the webtoon strip glides after a fling.
* Decoded images now have a memory limit, so long chapters no longer keep growing in memory.
* Fixed: lost decoded pages for the next chapter when closing the reader, and chapter list rows with a scanlator failing to lay out.

## Video player

* New controls on phone, desktop and TV, with episodes reachable from the top bar and lock and skip under the timeline on mobile.
* **Video filters:** brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and hue, kept for the next episodes. Gamma is hidden where the video output cannot apply it.
* **Audio delay:** from -5 to +5 seconds.
* Remember volume and brightness between episodes, and keep the fit from one episode to the next.
* New "Turn subtitles on" switch, so episodes can start without subtitles.
* "Use my subtitle style" now really gives the default style back when turned off.
* VAAPI and VDPAU hardware decoding on Linux.
* Rebind the player's keyboard shortcuts.
* Fixed: a freeze in the player's event handling, crashes when chapter marks change, previous and next buttons on mobile, and controls under the camera cutout in landscape.

## Library and browsing

* Swipe sideways to switch between Manga, Anime and Novels, in the library and in Browse.
* Select everything between two entries, in the library and in chapter lists.
* Skip completed series, series with unread chapters or series not started in library updates. The categories' "Skip updates" option now takes effect too.
* The Updates badge counts what was found since you last opened Updates, and clears when you visit.
* Hidden media types are respected everywhere: Browse, Updates, History and the tracker library.
* Browse remembers the Sources or Extensions page picked for each media.
* Recommendation cards use the available space and no longer show HTML tags.
* Fixed: opening Updates and History with orphan chapters, and an empty random entry.

## Downloads

* Download the next 2, 3, 5 or 10 unread chapters while reading.
* Download new chapters after a library update.
* "Delete download after reading" can remove a chapter 1 to 4 back instead, and keeps bookmarked chapters.
* Failed downloads wait before retrying, and follow what a server asks after a 429 or 503.
* Fixed: complete downloads being held back by the series cover, and resumed archives not finishing.

## Tracking

* New on-device tracker, with its own shelf in the tracker library.
* Redrawn tracking card.
* Progress now reaches trackers even if you leave the screen first.

## Extensions

* Updates are found in every repository, and the app says which one they come from. An update from another repository asks for confirmation before it is installed.
* Extension WebViews are hosted for the extension server, including network and media capture.
* Faster extension installs.
* Repositories with empty source lists are supported.
* Fixed: sources that read a setting in their headers failing to install, and video qualities lost with multiple hosters.

## Backup, restore and sync

* Reading time and last-read dates are kept when restoring backups from other apps.
* Anime is kept from backups of unrecognised forks.
* Local archive favorites are included in backups.
* A backup password is only requested when the password is really the problem.
* Refreshing a catalog keeps your reading state, and duplicate chapters are merged safely.
* Fixed: logging in to the sync server on macOS.

## Security and privacy

* **Secure screen:** keep the app out of screenshots and the recent apps preview, always or only in incognito mode.
* **Lock after:** ask to authenticate after 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes away, or only when the app starts.

## Updates and first launch

* Onboarding starts by asking for your language.
* Clearer update dialog: installed and new version, date, size, sorted notes and what happens next. You will see it from the next update onwards.
* Pre-releases are now ordered correctly when checking for updates.
* New open source licenses screen in About.
* New Persian translation, and the missing strings translated in every language.

## Platforms

* **Android:** fixed a crash where all files access cannot be granted.
* **Android TV:** fixed the Player settings in the anime-only layout, and the repository added on the welcome screen is filed under anime.
* **iOS:** local files stay inside their folder.
* **macOS:** the app icon now fits the system's icon grid.
* **Windows:** sharper 256 px icon, used by the installer too, and more readable crash reports.
* **Linux:** choose which browser opens external links; JPEG is read whichever libjpeg version is installed; fixed webview window crashes.

## Stability and performance

* Faster database queries and lower memory use.
* The next chapter preloads on a new page rather than on every frame.
* A page that lost its data now offers a way back instead of crashing.
* The startup error screen says what to do when the database cannot open.
* Handled errors are now recorded, and developer mode shows them with their details.

## Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release: @adobex, @aliafshany, @itsyaba, @Lukas-DS, @matsukiender-star, @MenaHere, @NBA2K1 and @Totara-thib.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.9...v0.9.95

cuerpo.name: v0.9.7
cuerpo.body:
# What's New

## Reader

* **Reliable Resume to Saved Position** :
  * Reopening a chapter in continuous vertical reading now jumps directly and instantly to the page where you left off, even before all images have finished loading.
  * Eliminated the issue where the reader would land on a neighboring page or spinner instead of the correct saved position.

* **Smoother Zoomed Panning & Inertia** (#1021):
  * Dragging a zoomed page now follows your finger precisely using real movement delta instead of an accumulated offset, making panning far more responsive.
  * Flinging a zoomed page now carries natural momentum with a longer, smoother coast animation.
  * Overscrolling past the edge of a zoomed page automatically transfers the momentum to the page list scroll, allowing seamless continued scrolling without lifting your finger.

* **Fixed Grey Screen in Double-Page Mode**:
  * Chapter transition pages in vertical double-page reading no longer cause a crash or a blank grey screen when the spread is reached.

* **Reader Bottom Bar Positioning**:
  * The page slider and quick-action bar now correctly sit above the system gesture area and home indicator on all devices, preventing them from being hidden behind system UI.

* **Novel Reader Performance**:
  * Page swipes in paged novel mode no longer trigger a full rebuild of the reader tree, making navigation between pages considerably faster.

---

## Fixes & Stability

* Fixed infinite loading spinner when resuming a continuous vertical chapter mid-chapter.
* Corrected the visible range check that was preventing the initial scroll anchor from being applied reliably.
* Page image load events now correctly trigger a re-jump to the saved position if the list had not yet settled on the right page.

---

## Contributors

* @kodjodevf

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.6...v0.9.7

cuerpo.name: v0.9.6
cuerpo.body:
# What's New

## 📖 Reader & Manga

* **Intelligent Double-Page Spreads & RTL Reading** (#1018, #1008):
  * Wide and landscape double-page spreads are now shown seamlessly on their own full-width screen instead of being awkwardly paired with single pages.
  * Switching between single and double-page view, rotating your device, or changing reading modes no longer resets your progress back to chapter 1.
  * Resuming chapters in Right-to-Left (manga) reading mode now starts in the correct direction without layout flipping.
* **Instant Border Cropping & Cache Improvements**:
  * Turning border crop on or off in Webtoon / continuous reading now applies instantly without re-downloading the images.
  * Fixed an issue where resuming a chapter at a saved page could cause an infinite loading spinner for already cached images.
* **Smoother Reading Experience**:
  * Fixed page flickering and display glitches when scrolling quickly through continuous chapters.

---

## Novel Reader

* **Scroll-Free E-Reader Paged Mode** (#1019):
  * Read novels like a real book with page-turning swipes and taps instead of endless vertical scrolling.
  * Quickly switch between **Continuous Scroll** and **Paged Reading** directly from the novel settings sheet.
* **Single & Double-Page Column Layouts** (#1019):
  * Added single-page and side-by-side double-page reading modes, optimized for tablets, foldable devices, and landscape screens.
  * Settings sheet changes (reading mode, page mode) are now applied and previewed instantly.

---

## Video Player & Anime

* **Player Screen Lock (Mobile)**:
  * Added a dedicated screen lock button to the mobile controls to prevent accidental touches while watching.
  * When locked, all on-screen controls, touch gestures (swiping to seek, volume/brightness, double-tap jump, 2x speed hold), and the skip button are completely disabled.
  * Protects against accidentally exiting the player with the back button or back gesture.
  * Tap anywhere on the locked screen to display a quick-unlock button in the top-left corner.
* **Cleaner Seek Indicator**:
  * Simplified and streamlined the swipe-to-seek visual overlay on the player.

---

## Features & User Experience

* **Smoother Category Management**:
  * Reordering categories in settings is now much more responsive and intuitive using dedicated drag handles.
* **Details Header Polish**:
  * Improved visual layout and formatting in the manga/anime details header.

---

## Fixes & Stability

* **Reliable Background Sync**:
  * Fixed occasional crashes and errors that could occur when closing screens or navigating away during library synchronization.

---

## Localization

* Added translations for the new player screen lock feature across all supported languages.

---

## Contributors

* @kodjodevf
* @jikkun (#1018, #1019)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.5...v0.9.6

cuerpo.name: v0.9.5
cuerpo.body:
## What's Changed

## Reader & Novels

* **Smart Double-Page Mode** (#1008):
  * Automatically switch to double-page view based on screen orientation (landscape/portrait).
  * Chapter transition pages now remain isolated for a natural, seamless reading experience.
* **Complete Novel Reader Overhaul** (#1014):
  * Added double-page reading mode support for novels.
  * Added a **Keep screen on** toggle to prevent the display from turning off while reading (#1014).
  * Added smooth auto-scroll with fine-tuned speed controls.
  * Redesigned Novel bottom bar and settings sheets: more compact, with quick font-size adjustments.
  * Centralized all novel settings under **More > Settings > Novel Reader** (#1014).
* **Smooth Webtoon Scrolling**:
  * Much smoother continuous scrolling without stutter or layout jumps.
  * Fluid auto-scroll that reacts instantly to touch and drag gestures.
* **Reliable Page Error Recovery**:
  * The **Retry** button is now immediately clickable with no menu overlay interference.
  * Added a manual **Refresh** button in the reader top bar to re-fetch fresh pages from the source.
* **Dedicated Page Cache**:
  * Redesigned chapter caching system (100 MB disk limit with automatic cleanup of older files) to save storage and speed up loading times.

---

##  Features & User Experience

* **Quick Resume from History** (#1005):
  * Double-tap or double-click the **History** icon in the navigation bar to instantly jump straight back into your latest read chapter or watched episode (filtered by Manga, Anime, or Novel).
* **One-Tap Global Search**:
  * Tap any title in the entry details header to immediately search for it across all extensions (long-press continues to copy to clipboard).
  * Warns you before adding an entry that is already in your library.
* **Customizable Chapter Swipe Actions** (#1005):
  * Configure left and right swipe gestures for chapters in Reader settings (Mark as Read/Unread, Bookmark, Download, or Disable).
* **Mass Migration from Library** (#1005):
  * Added a dedicated shortcut button in the multi-select bottom action bar to quickly migrate multiple selected entries at once.
* **Automatic Sync** (#1012):
  * Added background auto-sync support and improved sync preference handling.

---

## Video Player & Desktop

* **Desktop Controls & Performance** (#1015):
  * Eliminated stutter caused by mouse hover on the player controls.
  * Added a setting to toggle hardware acceleration on Windows.
* **Audio & Subtitle Tracks**:
  * Better track synchronization, duplicate removal, and cleaner track labels.

---

##  Localization

* Fully updated and completed translations across **17 languages** (French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more).

---

##  Fixes & Stability

* Fixed visual layout overflow issues in settings sheets and bottom bars (#1014).
* Improved error handling and reliability for Kitsu discovery (#1011).
* File picker improvements and stability updates (#1010).

---

##  Contributors

* @kodjodevf 
* @NBA2K1 (#1010, #1011)
* @not-akari


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.4...v0.9.5
